verdict.rationale: No vendor documentation in the evidence pack addresses predictable pricing, record-based cost caps, or protections against per-request cost cliffs. In fact, independent community reports describe the opposite experience — costs 'get expensive at scale,' a 'price per search model' criticized as 'ridiculous,' and users unexpectedly multiplying record usage (30K→150K) via duplicate indexes for sorting, leading companies to switch providers over cost surprises.
